inspected: First page title, authors and arXiv version compared with primary arXiv API metadata
claims: CLadder generates more than 10,000 formal causal questions across three rungs, with commonsense, nonsensical and anti-commonsense verbalizations.
Table 2 reports GPT-4 accuracy 62.03% and CausalCoT 70.40% on dataset v1.5; all outcomes are paper-reported historical model results.
The authors identify language-to-formal-tool formulation as a remaining challenge even when a causal engine exists.
sources.cutoff_status: PDF version stamp matches API version; version date no later than 2026-10-07
sources.inspection_scope: Only the explicit page anchors and associated claims; not a claim that every page was reviewed.

anchors.section: Contributions and Section 2: formal identification and the causal ladder
Section 7: query limits and language-to-tool interface

adverse_findings_and_limits: Binary question accuracy does not measure bank identification validity, effect coverage or decision loss.
The benchmark covers selected graph/query families; natural-language paraphrases and anti-commonsense stories do not prove absence of all contamination.
Do not repeat unverified proprietary-model parameter counts from the experimental description.
sources.project_disposition: Inspect generator and license for later held-out formal-query fixtures; preserve nonidentification and target parsing metrics.
sources.implementation_qualification: none; author-reported research is distinct from local execution

sources.title: CausalDS: Benchmarking Causal Reasoning in Data-Science Agents
sources.local_path: docs/papers/CausalDS Benchmarking Causal Reasoning in Data-Science Agents Leban(2026).pdf
sources.cutoff_status: First-page identity and PDF version stamp inspected; matched API version date no later than cutoff
claims: CausalDS provides narrated synthetic SCM scenes, data files, a separate observation model and private scoring artifacts.
Interventional and counterfactual targets have separate identification decisions, with abstention on nonidentifiable tasks.
The paper reports a 100-scene exam sampled from 953 scenes and finds that symbolic success, interval quality, abstention and cost can diverge.
sources.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.
adverse_findings_and_limits: Identification is defined for conceptual variables; the paper explicitly distinguishes their noisy observed proxies. An adapter must preserve this distinction.
The reported leaderboard is a dated author evaluation, not evidence of model performance or costs measured here.
A generated story with hidden ground truth is a useful test setting, but does not establish authentic bank semantic/assignment truth.
sources.project_disposition: High-priority candidate benchmark architecture; inspect generator and scoring before any reuse, retaining failures and repeatability.
